name: print-social-retail-shelf-shipper-display-concepts
title: Back-to-school shelf shippers, end cap and flag display concepts
whatItIs: A presentation of in-store display concepts for a gummy vitamin brand. Six shipper racks are topped with illustrated yellow school buses and a crayon box; a backpack-shaped display shows product; an end cap has bright blue shelves; and an 'only at' flag sits on white. Labels 'SHELF SHIPPER', 'END CAP' and 'FLAG' are in black tape-like strips.
whatItMeans: Playful and seasonal, making a supplement feel like a school-day companion; strong colour blocks make it visible across a store.
techniques: Use a seasonal icon (school bus, crayons) as a topper to turn shelving into a character.
Colour-code shelf bands by product to organise a wall.
Label sections with black tape-like strips against a crumpled paper backdrop.
Make a tall display echo a familiar shape (backpack) with zippers and pockets.

vocabulary.definition: A display unit that ships pre-loaded with product.
A display at the end of a store aisle.
A themed graphic placed above a display.
A coloured strip identifying a row of products.
